remarks: Welcome to this inviting single-story home in the desirable Wildwood community of Thousand Oaks! Offering 3 bedrooms and 2 baths and 1556 square feet, the open layout creates comfortable spaces for everyday living and entertaining. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, recessed lighting and a cheerful breakfast nook, opening to a family room with a cozy fireplace. Vaulted ceilings and plantation shutters enhance the living room, which flows into the dining room. Two generously sized secondary bedrooms share a remodeled hall bath with an updated vanity.
